note: Graphic overlays drawn by kit/overlay.html as captions.js flips (modes 9 to 23). Original generic designs, drawn in code with the theme's colours and fonts; no third-party icons. Bring your own icon, image or screen recording where a graphic takes one, or the kit draws a neutral placeholder. Listed in npm run menu, the showcase, contract.json and the teardown mapping (kit/videomd2reel.cjs). Words on screen follow kit/spoken.cjs: the fields under "spoken" must be words you say in the graphic's window, or a recipe job drops them. "layer" on modes 11 to 23 is front, behind or auto: behind draws on the panel layer under the crown mask (kit/headmask.py), so only the top of your head (hair and crown) goes over the graphic, never your face or chin. auto is behind for a screen card, and for the others behind when the graphic sits in the top part of the frame (its y below "autoBehindY").

graphics.label: list number sticker: an italic serif word (FIRST, SECOND, NEXT) over a spiky starburst; the burst can sit behind your head

fields.layer: front or behind (the burst goes behind the person when a mask is set)
fields.size: burst radius in pixels on the 1080-wide frame (default 400)
fields.head: burst width in head widths (a teardown measures it; the remake measures your head and sets size and y)
fields.head-y: burst centre below the head centre, in head widths

graphics.detect: a large pale or saturated yellow region with a spiky outline (low solidity), plus a short ordinal word read on screen at the same time

graphics.label: app or logo label: a square icon tile and a bold label with a white outline; your icon image, or a generic glyph

fields.icon: image file (png, jpg, svg) relative to build/ or absolute; leave out for a generic glyph
fields.tile: tile colour for the generic glyph (default the theme accent)
fields.size: tile side in pixels on the 1080-wide frame (default 210)

graphics.detect: a small square tile (rectangular outline, distinct colour) with a short label read just below or beside it

graphics.label: screen card: a rounded dark card with a coloured border, inset in the lower middle, showing your screenshot or screen recording

fields.src: image or video file (a screen recording plays in the card); leave out for a generic placeholder window
fields.source: a public page (a repo, a site, a tool) captured by npm run capture to a screenshot and a short scrolling recording, or a file
fields.subject: what the reference showed in the card (written by a teardown as subject~)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto, which is behind: the top of your head goes over the card where it reaches into it; your face and body stay under it)

graphics.detect: a rounded rectangle with a dark inside and a straight outline, wide and in the lower half, with small UI text read inside it

graphics.label: lower third name tag: an accent bar wipes up, then a plate slides out with your name and a small line under it

fields.sub: the small line, e.g. what you do (optional)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: a short horizontal plate in the lower third with a coloured bar at its left edge and one or two lines of text

graphics.label: big number callout: the number counts up to its value in the accent colour, a label rises under it

fields.text: the number as you want it shown, e.g. 10,000+ or 3x or 40%
fields.sub: the label under it, e.g. readers
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: one very large number on its own, with a short label under it

graphics.label: checklist card: rows drop in, and each box ticks as you say its item

fields.items: the rows, separated by ; (each ticks when you say it; a recipe job drops rows you never say)
fields.at: tick times in reel seconds, one per row (a recipe job sets them from your words; else spread over the card)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: a card with two or more short rows, each with a square or round box at its left

graphics.label: quote card: big quote marks pop, the line fades in word by word in an italic serif, with a small attribution under it

fields.color: quote mark and rule colour (default the theme accent)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

example.text: Record one take and let the kit do the rest

graphics.detect: a few lines of serif or italic text with large quotation marks

graphics.label: hand-drawn highlight: a circle, arrow, underline or box draws itself on, with an optional short label at its tail

fields.shape: circle, arrow, underline or box (default circle)
fields.text: a short label at the arrow's tail or beside the shape (optional)
fields.x: centre x of the shape (or the arrow's tip), 0..1 (default 0.5)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: a thin hand-drawn stroke (circle, arrow or underline) over the picture

graphics.label: step counter: a pill with STEP 2 OF 5 and a segmented progress bar that fills to the current step

fields.text: the word before the number (default Step; the numbers are layout, a word you set is checked against what you say)
fields.color: filled segment colour (default the theme accent)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: a small pill near the top with a word and a number, often over a row of short bars

graphics.label: versus card: two halves slide in from the sides and a VS badge slams between them

fields.text: or both at once: Manual vs Agent
fields.color: right half and badge colour (default the theme accent)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: two side-by-side panels of different colour with a small VS between them

graphics.label: round icon badge: spins in while its ring draws round; a built-in glyph or your icon, with an optional label pill

fields.glyph: built-in glyph: check, star, bolt, heart, fire, play, bell, spark, plus or lock (default check)
fields.icon: your image (png, jpg, svg) instead of the glyph
fields.text: a short label pill under the badge (optional)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: a round badge with a ring and a single symbol inside

graphics.label: reaction stickers: a little cluster of die-cut stickers (hearts, stars, fire, sparks) pops in around a point and floats up

fields.glyph: heart, star, fire, spark, check, bolt, or several separated by ; (default heart;star;spark)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: several small white-outlined stickers or emoji scattered in a cluster

graphics.label: price tag: a tag drops in on a string and swings to rest, the price big on it and an old price struck through above

fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: a tag-shaped plate with a hole at one end and a price on it

graphics.label: call-to-action end card: a card rises with your line and handle, and a follow button pulses

fields.text: the line, e.g. Follow for more
fields.sub: your handle, e.g. @theaigent (checked against what you say, run together: the aigent counts)
fields.glyph: the button glyph: plus, bell or play (default plus)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: a card near the end with a short line, a handle and a button shape

graphics.label: code snippet card: an editor window with line numbers, the code typing itself on in a monospace face with light syntax colour

fields.text: the code; \n starts a new line (it is your code, like a screen card's screen, so it is not checked against what you say)
fields.title: the tab name (default the language-neutral main)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto: behind when y is below 0.45, so the top of your head can tuck over it; your face and chin never cover it)

graphics.detect: a dark rounded card with monospace text and line numbers
